original_forecast.resolution_rule: Probability terminal close exceeds 7,757.64. Use official/index-provider or major financial-data close, consistently.
rationale: Record-high momentum and strong technology leadership support the upside base rate.
Payroll contraction and major inflation releases create near-term downside/event risk.
High nominal yields constrain valuation expansion.
surprising_if: Credit spreads widen sharply while SPX remains persistently at new highs.

resolution.source: Reuters Sep. 8, 2026 U.S. market close; AP independently reported the same S&P 500 close.
resolution.audit_note: Original forecast content is preserved without hindsight alteration. The up event resolved FALSE because 7,673.52 was below the frozen 7,757.64 starting close. The 0.54 probability lost to a neutral 0.50 comparator and the 7,820 point forecast lost materially to frozen no-change, while the broad 80% interval covered. This is negative out-of-sample probability and point-forecast evidence but not an interval-tail failure.
